purpose: Teach: 右足/ピル/人妻/男児/牙/疾走/歓喜/先導

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の右足靴の痕跡を、警察、鑑識されますね
lines.en: So with this case, the police do conduct forensic analysis on the suspect's right shoe impressions, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost pedagogical. Pause before the key detail. Steady, measured tempo. Checking understanding rather than asking from ignorance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、未成年へのピル販売事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: And the police handle cases of pill sales to minors as well, I assume?
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice. Clear, matter-of-fact. Confirming a point that matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、人妻ストーカー事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: In this case, the police would also handle stalking incidents involving married women, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, building on the pattern. Even tone, no judgment. The third item in a list delivered as if testing the breadth of an answer.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、男児誘拐事件も厳しく捜査されますね
lines.en: And the police pursue kidnapping cases involving children with particular intensity, correct?
lines.style: Measured but with quiet weight behind it. The seriousness enters the tempo without raising volume. Respectful pause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犬の牙咬傷事故を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: This case would also fall under police jurisdiction—animal bite incidents, for instance?
lines.style: Still curious, slightly lighter. Moving through the list. Steady pacing, genuine wondering about the scope.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、疾走する逃走車両の追跡もされますね
lines.en: And the police provide security for high-speed pursuits of fleeing vehicles as well, I take it?
lines.style: Building momentum slightly. The concrete action in the words carries energy. Affirming rather than questioning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、宗教団体の歓喜祭での警備を、警察、担当されますね
lines.en: So the police also handle security at religious gatherings and festivals, that sort of thing?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause on the setup. Relaxed, almost conversational now. The tempo opens up—less formal than earlier.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、デモの先導車の警備もされますね
lines.en: And police provide security for protest lead vehicles and marches, of course.
lines.style: Direct, certain. No question mark in the voice. Stated as understood fact. Warm but grounded—the conversation landing somewhere solid.
